description:
This protocol automates the creation of a PCR Plate with a variable number of samples.

Using the Opentrons 4-in-1 Tube Rack with 2mL Eppendorf tubes, 20µL of pre-made master mix is added to PCR Plate. Following the addition of master mix to all necessary wells, 5µL of water is added for the negative control and 5µL of each sample is added to the other well(s).

If you have any questions about this protocol, please email our Applications Engineering team at protocols@opentrons.com.


To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our online store or contact our sales team at info@opentrons.com

Deck Layout

Slot 1: Opentrons 4-in-1 Tube Rack containing Samples (1-24)

Slot 2: Bio-Rad 96-Well PCR Plate, 200µL (Final PCR Plate)

Slot 3: Opentrons 4-in-1 Tube Rack
A1: Master Mix
D6: Negative Control (Water)

Slot 4: Opentrons 4-in-1 Tube Rack containing Samples (25-48)

Slot 7: Opentrons 4-in-1 Tube Rack containing Samples (49-72)

Slot 10: Opentrons 4-in-1 Tube Rack containing Samples (73-95)


Using the customizations field (below), set up your protocol.
* Number of Samples: Specify the number of samples to run (1-95).
